dishes.make_ahead: Make the cheese mixture up to 2 days ahead and keep it in the fridge; spread and grill just before serving

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour for a minute, then whisk in the milk until thick.
Off the heat stir in the cheddar, mustard, egg yolk, cayenne and pepper.
Toast the sourdough on one side under the grill, turn and spread thickly with the cheese mixture.
Grill until bubbling and blistered, scatter with spring onion and serve hot.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the chicken up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; crumb and fry on the night

ingredients.item: lemon, half juiced, half in wedges

steps.text: Mix the ginger garlic paste, lemon juice, cumin, turmeric, chilli powder, garam masala and salt and rub into the chicken.
Cover and marinate in the fridge.
Roll each piece in the semolina and breadcrumbs, dip in the beaten eggs and roll again.
Shallow-fry in 2cm of oil at 170C in batches, turning, until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towel.
Serve hot with lemon wedges and the chutney.

veg.make_ahead: Spice the cauliflower up to 1 day ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; crumb and fry on the night

ingredients.item: lemon, half juiced, half in wedges

steps.text: Mix the ginger garlic paste, lemon juice, cumin, turmeric, chilli powder, garam masala and salt and toss the cauliflower florets through it. Leave 20 minutes.
Steam or microwave the florets for 4 minutes until just soft at the stalks, then cool a little.
Roll the florets in the semolina and breadcrumbs, dip in the beaten eggs and roll again.
Shallow-fry in 2cm of hot oil in batches, 4 minutes, turning until deep golden. Drain on paper towel.
Serve hot with lemon wedges and the chutney.

dishes.n: Parsi family lamb dhansak with brown rice
dishes.make_ahead: Make the dhansak up to 2 days ahead, it gets better; cook the brown rice and kachumber on the night

ingredients.item: brown onions, 1 chopped, 1 thinly sliced for the rice

steps.text: Brown the lamb in 2 tbsp of the ghee in batches and lift out.
Fry the chopped onion until golden, add the ginger garlic paste, chillies, masala and cumin and cook 2 minutes.
Return the lamb with the toor dal, red lentils, pumpkin, eggplant, tomatoes, turmeric and 1.5 litres water. Cover and simmer until the lamb is soft.
Lift out the lamb, blend the dal roughly, return the lamb with the tamarind, brown sugar and half the salt and simmer 10 minutes.

For the rice, fry the sliced onion in the rest of the ghee until deep brown, add the sugar and let it caramelise, then add the cinnamon, rice, the rest of the salt and 3 cups water. Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes, then rest 5.
Toss the red onion, cucumber and tomato with the lime juice and a pinch of salt for the kachumber.
Scatter the dhansak with coriander and serve with the brown rice and the kachumber.

veg.n: Parsi family pumpkin and chickpea dhansak
veg.make_ahead: Make the dhansak up to 2 days ahead, it gets better; cook the brown rice and kachumber on the night

ingredients.item: brown onions, 1 chopped, 1 thinly sliced for the rice

steps.text: Simmer the toor dal and red lentils with the pumpkin, eggplant, tomatoes, turmeric and 1.25 litres water for 40 minutes until it all collapses, then mash or blend roughly.
Fry the chopped onion in 2 tbsp of the ghee until golden, add the ginger garlic paste, chillies, masala and cumin and cook 2 minutes.
Stir the spices into the dal with the chickpeas, tamarind, brown sugar and half the salt and simmer 20 minutes.

For the rice, fry the sliced onion in the rest of the ghee until deep brown, add the sugar and let it caramelise, then add the cinnamon, rice, the rest of the salt and 3 cups water. Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes, then rest 5.
Toss the red onion, cucumber and tomato with the lime juice and a pinch of salt for the kachumber.
Scatter the dhansak with coriander and serve with the brown rice and the kachumber.

dishes.make_ahead: Blend the chutney up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; wrap the fish up to 4 hours ahead and steam on the night

ingredients.item: firm white fish fillets, about 150g each
pieces banana leaf or baking paper

steps.text: Soak the coconut in 3 tbsp hot water for 5 minutes, then blend with the herbs, chillies, garlic, cumin, sugar, juice of a lime and salt to a thick paste.
Soften the banana leaf over a flame or in hot water.
Coat each fillet thickly in chutney and wrap in a piece of leaf, tied with string.
Steam over simmering water until the fish flakes.
Serve in the leaf with lime wedges to open at the table.

steps.text: Soak the coconut in 3 tbsp hot water, then blend with the herbs, chillies, garlic, cumin, sugar, lime juice and salt.
Coat the paneer thickly in chutney and wrap in softened banana leaf, tied with string.
Steam over simmering water until hot through. Serve with lime wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 2 days ahead and keep covered in the fridge; serve cold or warm it gently

steps.text: Simmer the milk in a wide pan, stirring often, until reduced by about a third.
Stir in the condensed milk and cool a little.
Heat the oven to 160C and butter a 20cm baking dish. Whisk in the eggs, cardamom, a grating of nutmeg and vanilla, then strain into the dish.
Scatter with the almonds and bake in a water bath until just set and golden on top.
Cool a little before serving, or chill.

s.note: Toasted sourdough under a grilled sauce of sharp cheddar, mustard, milk and egg yolk, with cayenne and spring onion
s.how: Melt 30g butter in a pan, stir in 2 tbsp flour for a minute, then whisk in 150ml milk until thick. Off the heat stir in 250g grated sharp cheddar, 2 tsp English mustard, 1 egg yolk, a pinch of cayenne and black pepper. Toast 8 thick slices of sourdough on one side under the grill, turn, spread thickly with the cheese mixture right to the edges and grill for 3 to 4 minutes until bubbling and blistered. Scatter with sliced spring onion and serve hot.

s.note: Parsi fried chicken marinated in ginger, garlic, chilli and spice, crumbed in semolina and egg, with lemon and mango chutney
s.how: Mix 2 tbsp ginger garlic paste, the juice of half a lemon, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp garam masala and 1 tsp salt and rub into 1kg chicken drumettes and wings. Marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours. Roll each piece in a mix of 60g fine semolina and 60g breadcrumbs, dip in 3 beaten eggs and roll again. Shallow-fry in 2cm of oil at 170C for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until deep golden and cooked through. Drain and serve with lemon wedges and mango chutney.

m.n: Parsi family lamb dhansak with brown rice
m.note: Lamb simmered in a spiced dal of lentils, pumpkin, eggplant and tamarind, with caramelised onion brown rice and kachumber
m.how: Brown 1kg diced lamb shoulder in 2 tbsp ghee and lift out. Fry 1 chopped onion until golden, add 2 tbsp ginger garlic paste, 2 slit green chillies, 2 tbsp dhansak masala and 1 tsp cumin for 2 minutes. Return the lamb with 1 cup toor dal, 1/2 cup red lentils, 300g diced pumpkin, 1 diced eggplant, 2 chopped tomatoes, 1 tsp turmeric and 1.5 litres water. Simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours until the lamb is soft. Lift out the lamb, blend the dal roughly, then return the lamb with 1 tbsp tamarind, 1 tbsp brown sugar and salt and simmer 10 minutes. For the rice, fry 1 sliced onion in 2 tbsp ghee until deep brown, add 1 tbsp sugar to caramelise, then a cinnamon stick, 2 cups rinsed basmati, salt and 3 cups water. Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes and rest 5. Toss red onion, cucumber and tomato with lime for the kachumber. Serve the dhansak with coriander, the rice and the kachumber.

w.note: Parsi wedding custard of reduced milk, condensed milk, eggs, cardamom and nutmeg, baked golden under flaked almonds
w.how: Simmer 1 litre full cream milk in a wide pan, stirring often, for 25 minutes until reduced by about a third. Stir in a 395g tin condensed milk and cool for 15 minutes. Heat the oven to 160C. Whisk in 4 eggs, 1/2 tsp ground cardamom, a good grating of nutmeg and 1 tsp vanilla, then strain into a buttered 20cm baking dish. Scatter with 40g flaked almonds and bake in a water bath for 45 minutes until just set and golden on top. Serve warm or cold.

d.note: Cold lager topped half and half with lemonade, with a lemon wedge, in a chilled pint glass
d.how: Chill 4 pint glasses. Half fill each with cold lager, tilting the glass, then top up with cold lemonade and drop in a lemon wedge.
